sea_rise.css: @keyframes sea_rise { 0% { transform: translateY(100%); } 100% { transform: translateY(20%); } } .sea-rise-fill { animation: sea_rise 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

btn_hover.css: .btn-primary { transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .btn-primary:hover { background: #1B4332; transform: translateY(-1px); }

home.layout: Full-bleed photographic hero with climate clock overlay, stat strip, three campaign cards, impact numbers band on sage, stories grid, monthly giving CTA on terra cotta.

science.layout: Editorial single-column with embedded SVG temperature line chart, decade-comparison bar chart, animated sea level visualization, and FAQ accordion below.

action.layout: Grid of action pathway cards (donate, petition, contact rep, volunteer) with prominent petition signature counter and embedded local action map.

stories.layout: Long-form journalism feed with large photography, pull quotes, video testimonial blocks, and an impact location map at top.

about.layout: Mission statement, team grid with bios, financial transparency pie chart, press logo strip, and annual report download CTA.
